Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.in.http.dto.ledger

Record Class KfeDashboardWallet

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.in.http.dto.ledger.KfeDashboardWallet
Record Components:
walletId - stable identifier of the wallet
kind - backend wallet category used by routing and accounting
status - current lifecycle state of the wallet
label - user-facing label assigned to the wallet
walletName - persisted wallet name used for lookup and display
walletTypeDescription - human-readable description of the wallet type
asset - asset ticker represented by the balance fields
spendable - whether policy currently permits spending from this wallet
availableSats - confirmed amount available for a new operation
pendingSats - amount involved in operations that have not settled
lockedSats - amount held by explicit wallet or transaction locks
autoHoldSats - amount withheld automatically by wallet policy
observedSats - amount observed on chain but not yet spendable
activeAddress - currently assigned receiving address, if available
createdAt - wallet creation timestamp
updatedAt - timestamp of the latest wallet state update
public record KfeDashboardWallet(UUID walletId, String kind, String status, String label, String walletName, String walletTypeDescription, String asset, boolean spendable, long availableSats, long pendingSats, long lockedSats, long autoHoldSats, long observedSats, String activeAddress, Instant createdAt, Instant updatedAt) extends Record
Wallet balance and lifecycle information displayed on the KFE dashboard.
